reasons.record_complete: Record is incomplete and inconsistent: backfill batching unspecified against a conditional approval, backup unverified (last verified 6 days ago), load test not run, capacity extrapolation far exceeds the 90-minute window, rollback untested.
reasons.change_decision: The scheduled window conflicts with the declared sales event on the checkout-critical orders table and cannot hold the projected backfill, so the conservative move-to-quiet-window preference dominates; missing batching details keep return-for-information and board escalation plausible.
reasons.change_risk: Running as scheduled combines a destructive schema change on checkout/payments, an 80-million-row backfill exceeding the window by roughly tenfold, untested rollback, no verified backup, and a live sales-event conflict, putting risk at High to Very high.
